title: AI接口加速电池研究：FINALES与Kadi4Mat协同优化
summary: 本研究提出一个框架，通过FINALES与Kadi4Mat生态系统的互操作性，利用多目标贝叶斯优化算法，在钠离子电池形成过程中平衡形成时间与寿命性能，加速电池研究并减少实验资源消耗。
summary_en: This study presents a framework enabling interoperability between FINALES and Kadi4Mat ecosystems, using multi-objective Bayesian optimization to balance formation time and EOL performance in sodium-ion coin cells, accelerating battery research with fewer experiments.
